newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: TABLE - CIH raises interim shr, no div.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - CIH raises interim shr, no div.

text.p: Full name: Commercial and Industrial Holdings Limited.

NOTE - The group said capital investment in the second half of the year would remain high in keeping with the policy of reinforcing and upgrading core operations and this would facilitate further profitable growth. Considering the planned capital expenditure and resultant increased working capital required in the second half of the year, the board had resolved not to declare an interim dividend.
It said all divisions were optimistic for the July to December period with projected earnings per share of 18 cents for the year. A dividend would be considered when annual results were available.
